name: nova-industry-benchmark
description:
Nova Industry Benchmark Dataset
	

Evaluation data for Nova Mind models on industry-standard AI benchmarks.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains benchmark questions and Nova's responses across:

GSM8K - Mathematical reasoning
MMLU - Multi-domain knowledge
TruthfulQA - Truthfulness evaluation
HumanEval - Code generation
HellaSwag - Commonsense reasoning
Metacognition - Self-awareness evaluation
